note: v3 — **양측 게이트(기출 10~90% 대역) 중앙**을 통과한 소스로 만들었다. v1 은 대역 아래(어휘 쉬움), v2 는 대역 위(문장 김). v3 는 가운데다. 소스는 파이프라인 **자체 작문(cc0)** 두 편 — 즉 파이프라인이 이미 만들 수 있는 글이다. 기출 지문은 한 편도 쓰지 않았다. ⚠️ 2판: 처음에 또 짧게(570~800자) 잘랐다가 소스 A 전문에서 되살렸다 — v1 에서 겪은 실수를 세 번째 반복했다. 그 사실을 여기 적어 둔다.

items.passage: A block of flats is a single structure that many separate households share. Floors and walls are continuous, so a sound made in one room enters several others. The concrete carries a footstep as a slight shake rather than as air. That shake passes downward and sideways and arrives with no clear direction. A listener below hears the noise but cannot point to the room that produced it. Every dispute between neighbours begins inside a structure that leaves no mark of origin. Communities answer the problem with rules rather than with new walls. Quiet hours, floor coverings, and a channel for complaints are the usual three. None of these rules lowers the total amount of noise a building produces. What they change is when a sound may arrive and who must answer for it. A quiet hour moves the same footsteps into a period when the others are awake. A complaint channel supplies the mark that the concrete itself cannot give.
choices: engineering methods for reducing sound in concrete floors
legal penalties available to households in shared buildings
the difficulty of measuring loudness inside a block of flats
reasons why quiet hours fail in most residential communities
rules that manage a noise problem they cannot remove

items.passage: Households under such rules report fewer disputes, though instruments record no fall in loudness. A neighbour who knows that chairs move at eight simply stops listening for them. The same chairs at midnight feel louder, because nothing in the day predicted them. Surprise, not volume, is what makes a listener notice every sound and grow angry. Where the rules are honoured, residents accept sounds they had once called unbearable. Where the rules are ignored, a soft and irregular tap can empty a building of patience. The structure that opened this account has not been altered by any of these rules. Concrete still carries every step, and the building is no softer than before. What the rules alter is the ability of a listener to expect and to explain. So a complaint about noise is usually a complaint about not knowing. The quiet that people actually want is a quiet they can predict.
choices: Building Softer Walls: An Engineering Answer to Noise
Quiet Hours and the Law of Shared Housing
The Loudest Sound Is the One You Did Not Expect
Why Instruments Cannot Settle a Neighbour Dispute
Patience: The Forgotten Virtue of Apartment Living

items.passage: Infrastructure is rarely as independent as it ① appears. Romania's only nuclear station draws all of its cooling water from a single river, and that arrangement went unexamined for as long as the river ② behaved predictably. A prolonged spell of heat and drought in August lowered the Danube far beneath its normal level, and the consequences ③ followed in sequence. One of the two reactors had been taken offline a month earlier; on Thursday it closed the second, ④ suspended a plant that ordinarily supplies about a fifth of national electricity. Its director put the earliest restart at ten days away, which obliged the government to compensate through wind generation and imported power. Hungary, whose reactors rely on the same river, is now working ⑤ to prevent an identical outcome. Such episodes suggest that climate stress reaches critical systems by withdrawing a condition on which they quietly depend.
choices: appears
behaved
followed
suspended
to prevent
